meanings.en: to lead, to guide, to drive
вести себя: to behave, to conduct oneself
meanings.note: Вы как маленькая себя ведёте = You're behaving like a little girl

examples.trans: You're behaving like a little girl.
It is a cheerful comedy about love.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)
to choose, select; to use up completely (quotas, limits)

examples.text: В этом году все квоты выбрали.
examples.trans: This year all the quotas have been used up.
She chose the most beautiful dress.

выходить.gloss: to go out, to get out

meanings.en: to go out, to come out

examples.trans: I'm going out in a minute.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

examples.text: Девушки, как я, у тебя не будет!
examples.trans: You'll never have a girl like me!

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it
used with verbs like выходить for marriage of a woman
polite, or to several people; the first в is silent

meanings.en: to get acquainted, to meet (someone new)

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.trans: The Godfather is a famous film.

meanings.en: to stop, put an end to

meanings.en: dear, darling, my friend (in address: родной мой)
